request.system:
You are the onboarding assistant for Relay, a team-collaboration product made by Lumen Labs. You help the admin of a customer account set up their workspace.

Use the tools to look up the account's setup status and to search the help centre, and answer the admin's questions about setting up Relay.

If the admin asks for a person, or asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, hand off to a human with create_handoff.

Be helpful and concise.

messages.content: How do I deactivate a user who left, so they stop using a seat?

content.content:
{"query": "deactivate user free seat", "note": "At least one article covers this question.", "articles": [{"slug": "deactivate-user", "title": "Remove or deactivate a user", "score": 6.27, "coverage": 0.75, "covers_question": true, "text": "# Remove or deactivate a user

When someone leaves, an admin can deactivate them under Admin settings, Users. Find the person, open the menu at the end of the row and choose Deactivate.

Deactivating frees the seat at once. The person's cards, comments and documents stay where they are, and cards assigned to them show as unassigned. You can reactivate a user later and they get their history back.

Deleting a user permanently is only possible on request to support, because it cannot be undone.
"}, {"slug": "invite-users", "title": "Invite your team", "score": 3.42, "coverage": 0.75, "covers_question": true, "text": "# Invite your team

Admins invite people from Admin settings, Users, Invite. Type one email address per line or paste a list. Each invited person receives an email with a link that is valid for seven days.

You can invite as many people as you have licensed seats. A seat is used as soon as the invitation is sent, and freed again if you cancel the invitation or deactivate the user.

Tip: teams that invite at least five people in their first week are far more likely to keep using Relay, because boards are only useful when the work of several people is on them.

Search keywords: add people colleagues members team teammates new users invite invitation
"}, {"slug": "editions-comparison", "title": "Compare editions: Free, Standard, Premium, Enterprise", "score": 3.31, "coverage": 0.5, "covers_question": false, "text": "# Compare editions: Free, Standard, Premium, Enterprise

- Premium: 60 automation rules, 10 integrations, single sign-on, guests, and 40 Assist credits per seat per month.
- Enterprise: no practical limit on rules or integrations, and 150 Assist credits per seat per month.

This article describes features only. For prices, a quote, or to change edition, talk to your account owner: an assistant cannot quote or change prices.

content.text:
To deactivate someone who left:

1. Go to **Admin settings → Users**.
2. Find the person, open the **menu at the end of their row**, and choose **Deactivate**.

What happens next:
- **The seat is freed right away**, so you can give it to someone else.
- **Their cards, comments and documents stay where they are.** Any cards assigned to them will show as unassigned, so you may want to give those to someone else.
- **You can undo this.** If you reactivate them later, they get their history back.

If you want to delete the user permanently instead, only support can do that, because it can't be undone. For freeing a seat, deactivating is enough.
